files.castalla_current.glb: PRIMARY: terrain and castle already merged and aligned
files.terrain.glb: OPTIONAL: same terrain as primary scene, separated
files.castle.glb: OPTIONAL: same castle as primary scene, separated

rules: Do not auto-center the castle separately.
Do not normalize or rescale individual assets.
Do not rotate terrain or castle independently.
If separate files are used, load terrain.glb and castle.glb both at origin with identity transform.
Do not generate a replacement castle or replacement hill.
accuracyNote: Current recognizable Castalla reference; terrain is a controlled reconstruction, not raw LiDAR survey.
